prompt_text: How to launch a monthly giving program
response_text:
# How to Launch a Monthly Giving Program

## 1. **Planning & Setup**

**Set clear goals**
- Define revenue targets
- Determine ideal number of monthly donors
- Identify what the funds will support

**Choose your technology**
- Select a donation platform that supports recurring gifts (e.g., Donorbox, Classy, GiveWP)
- Ensure it integrates with your CRM/database
- Test the user experience thoroughly

**Determine giving levels**
- Offer 3-5 monthly amount options ($10, $25, $50, $100+)
- Show the impact of each level ("$25/month provides...")
- Make it easy to choose custom amounts

## 2. **Brand Your Program**

- Create a compelling name (e.g., "Circle of Hope," "Monthly Champions")
- Develop messaging around sustainability and ongoing impact
- Design visual identity (logo, colors, graphics)

## 3. **Build Your Case for Support**

- Explain why monthly giving matters
- Show predictable impact vs. one-time gifts
- Share stories of beneficiaries
- Emphasize convenience for donors

## 4. **Launch Strategy**

**Start with current supporters:**
- Email your most engaged one-time donors
- Call your top supporters personally
- Ask board members and volunteers first

**Create multiple touchpoints:**
- Dedicated landing page
- Email campaign series
- Social media promotion
- Direct mail piece
- Staff/volunteer outreach

## 5. **Donor Experience**

**Make it easy:**
- Simple sign-up process (2-3 clicks)
- Mobile-friendly forms
- Multiple payment options

**Provide recognition:**
- Welcome email series
- Special updates or insider content
- Exclusive events or benefits
- Recognition wall or honor roll

**Maintain engagement:**
- Quarterly impact reports
- Birthday/anniversary acknowledgments
- Annual thank-you gifts (optional)
- Easy account management portal

## 6. **Retention Focus**

- Monitor failed payments and follow up quickly
- Survey donors to understand their experience
- Provide upgrade opportunities
- Make cancellation difficult to find (but possible)
- Track retention rate monthly

## 7. **Marketing Calendar**

- **Month 1:** Soft launch to insiders
- **Month 2:** Public launch campaign
- **Month 3:** Follow-up and testimonials
- **Ongoing:** Regular promotion in all communications

## 8. **Measure Success**

Track these metrics:
- Number of monthly donors
- Average monthly gift
- Retention rate
- Lifetime value
- Acquisition cost

## Quick Tips

✅ Start small and build momentum
✅ Make the ask everywhere (website, emails, events)
✅ Use donor testimonials
✅ Emphasize the "less than a coffee per day" angle
✅ Celebrate milestones publicly

❌ Don't overcomplicate the sign-up process
❌ Don't neglect existing monthly donors while recruiting
❌ Don't ignore failed payments

**First 90 Days Checklist:**
- [ ] Technology set up and tested
- [ ] Program named and branded
- [ ] Landing page live
- [ ] Board members enrolled
- [ ] Launch email sent
- [ ] Social media campaign active
- [ ] Thank you process established

Monthly giving programs typically see significant growth after the first year as word spreads and the process becomes routine. Focus on retention as much as acquisition!
